admission.justification: The focused word-diff proofs guard hiding a removed condition or its changed words behind a collection summary, a costly semantic-review omission.

applicability: Conditions and exclusions in the selected subject intent word diff, including removed, added and paired changed items.
conditions: Every item has its own expandable state; Enter orSpace toggles the focused line.
Before/after marks remain on the visible line when closed, including both halves of a paired side-by-side item.
A rewrite keeps the existing wording-layout switch and explicit inline offer; collection-level summary folding and a new disclosure class are not introduced.
exclusions: Turning the whole condition collection into one summary disclosure.
A requirement that all subject content fit the first screen.
